children: Alset entered into a securities purchase agreement to buy a $500,000 convertible promissory note and warrants for 8,000,000 DSS shares. The note bears 3% simple interest and is convertible at $0.50 per share any time before its five-year maturity; the warrants carry a $0.55 exercise price and expire in five years. Conversion of the note and exercise of the warrants require DSS stockholder approval. The investment strengthens Alset's strategic position in an affiliate while offering potential equity upside.
